subject: Request: Accelerator boost - one-time credits + rate concession
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@astrahealth.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Accelerator pilot proposal & one-time credits

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. As discussed I've put together a proposal to make the pilot a low-friction evaluation for Astra Health: a 90-day pilot (standard is 30 days), $50,000 in platform credits redeemable against tokens/embeddings, and a 25% onboarding discount for the first quarter of paid usage.

Attached: Astra_Pilot_Proposal_v3.pdf which includes goals, SLO expectations, and suggested success metrics.

Quick notes:
- Credits are non-recurring and apply to hosted API usage.
- We can gate the deeper discount behind a 6-month commit if you want to convert early.
- Legal/procurement redlines are expected — we can fast-track them if you share the priority items.

If this matches what you need, can you confirm and loop in procurement? Procurement timelines are often the gating factor, so if they need a countersigned DocuSign we can prepare a redlined terms doc for review.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call today if helpful.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
From: Elena Torres <elena@astrahealth.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Astra Health Procure <procure@astrahealth.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Accelerator pilot proposal & one-time credits

Thanks Neha — this looks promising. Procurement and legal are cc'd; a couple of follow-ups from my side:

- Can Astra get 120 days instead of 90? Our evaluation window typically needs 4 months.
- Can credits be extended to support replicable PII-safe tests (we'll need higher token allowances early on)?
- Legal will want to see the redlined terms; they prefer to keep any credits non-refundable but need indemnity language clarified.

We're targeting an internal decision by EOD Wed (Nov 17). Can you escalate for executive approval if additional credits or an extended window is required? If so, please include your manager/leadership and any docs for quick review.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Data Products | Astra Health
elena@astrahealth.io
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: none
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Accelerator pilot proposal & one-time credits — exec approval request

Team — looping you both for a quick exec decision. Summary below (procurement deadline EOD Wed, 11/17):

Context:
- Target: Astra Health (large payer-tech prospect, strong expansion potential).
- Current ask from prospect: 120-day pilot, larger credit pool to support PII-safe testing.

Proposal we shared:
- 90-day pilot, $50k platform credits, 25% onboarding discount for Q1 paid usage. Attached: Astra_Pilot_Proposal_v3.pdf + redwood_terms_redlined.docx. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/49876

Request:
- Approve one-time exception to give: either (A) $50k credits + 90-day trial (our original), or (B) increase to $70k credits and 120-day pilot if leadership signs off.
- Approve a temporary 25% onboarding discount (or up to 30% if we move to $70k credit package).

Why worth exception:
- Astra integrates with several of our reference customers and has immediate use cases that will lead to high token volumes.
- If converted, expected ARR expansion >$300k over 18 months based on their product roadmap.

Risks/controls:
- Credits are one-time and expire after 120 days; legal can lock scope to non-production datasets unless we complete an MSA amendment for production.
- Require procurement signoff + countersigned DocuSign. I can prepare a redline with Legal.

Attachments: Astra_Pilot_Proposal_v3.pdf, redwood_terms_redlined.docx.
Urgency: need decision by Wed morning to meet procurement review timing.

Can you indicate preference and approval threshold? If you want to approve (B), I'll prepare the DocuSign and escalate to Legal for final language.

On Mon, Nov 15, 2027 at 09:12 AM Elena Torres <elena@astrahealth.io> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. As discussed I've put together a proposal to make the pilot a low-friction evaluation for Astra Health: a 90-day pilot (standard is 30 days), $50,000 in platform credits redeemable against tokens/embeddings, and a 25% onboarding discount for the first quarter of paid usage.
>
> Attached: Astra_Pilot_Proposal_v3.pdf which includes goals, SLO expectations, and suggested success metrics.

Appreciate the quick turn here.
Neha
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Intake <legal-intake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 14:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Accelerator pilot proposal & one-time credits — exec approval request

Neha — thanks for the crisp summary and for flagging urgency. I approve a constrained exception for Astra Health given the strategic fit and clear expansion opportunity. Approvals below:

Approved concession (final):
- Pilot length: 60-day extension (total 90 days) — we will not approve a full 120 day without a documented conversion trigger.
- Credits: $40,000 one-time platform credits (redeemable within the pilot window).
- Discount: 20% onboarding discount for the first paid quarter.

Conditions:
- Credits expire at the end of the pilot window; any overage billed at standard rates.
- Legal must review redlined terms and sign off before any countersignature. I'll ask Legal to prioritize.
- Procurement: require counter-signed DocuSign. Neha, please prepare the DocuSign envelope and include the redlined doc (redwood_terms_redlined.docx).

Rationale: this reduces our downside vs. the original ask while keeping a compelling offer for Astra. If they commit to a six-month minimum by the end of the pilot we can revisit the credit top-up as a convert incentive.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
